framing: He Was Socrates earns its first five seconds with a single composed frame — bust, breath, and a Korean question — so that judges feel the abstention mechanic before they read about it.
target_persona: Kaggle / Google DeepMind judges who decide in five seconds whether to scroll; the frame must resolve into product-feel, not slide-deck.
primary_surface: The macOS app's idle launch screen rendered as a single hero plate: 1-bit halftone bust centered on ink-black, soft Phase.thinking pulse, status caption '흉상 깨우는 중', Times-serif headline 'He was Socrates.', Korean subtitle '너의 물음은 무엇인가', and a Space-key push-to-talk affordance — no buttons, no chrome, no explainer sections.
opus_4_7_capability: Configurable thinking mode rendered as a calm visual metaphor — a sub-second breath cycle on the bust that translates Phase.thinking from log line into felt aesthetic, paired with the function-calling tone-lock surfaced verbatim in 단정한 평어체.
mvp_scope: One self-contained HTML frame: inline halftone bust SVG, OKLCH bone-on-ink palette, breathing pulse animation, status overlay, English serif headline + Korean subtitle + Space affordance, four corner status markers (Phase / On-Device / Gemma 4 E4B / Tone Lock), and a single below-frame legend explaining 'this is the macOS app, not a webpage.'
one_liner_pitch: The first frame is the pitch: an ink-black mac screen, a halftone bust breathing under '너의 물음은 무엇인가', and the abstention mechanic implied by every empty pixel.
